title: Democracia y justicia
goal: Read how Brazil took a starkly different path from Argentina or Chile -- a 1979 self-amnesty upheld by its own Supreme Court in 2010, the same year the Inter-American Court ruled it incompatible with international law.

items: Explain what Brazil's 1979 Amnesty Law did.
State what Brazil's Supreme Court ruled in 2010.
Explain what the Inter-American Court ruled in the Gomes Lund case.
Describe Brazil's response to that international ruling.
Use hacer caso omiso de to describe deliberately disregarding something.
